title: Gate Mark
origin: A gate engine burned its toll-mark into bone and recognizes the operative at every ring.
burdenText: The first cross-ring transition each round requires 1 Salvage or inflicts 1 Wound.
adaptationText: Gain +1 Command or Signal on an authored gate or transition test.
text: A customs sigil under your skin declares you taxable cargo.
flavor: Every locked door recognizes the stamp before it recognizes you.
trigger: When you cross into a center or inner space.
relief: Complete a dominion contract to mark the toll paid for the rest of the session.
upside: If you pay the trophy, gain a route note about the gate's next demand.
